source_player: Теперь скачек. Шики в скачке должен разительно раскачаться по всем характеристикам и генетике. Он должен вести тайные исследования по ассимиляции генов и должен произвести хотя бы пару успешных ассисиляций. Пусть тайно изымет кекейгенкай льда у хакку. Скорость на уровне и вшие шисуи. Цель средней дистанции получить шаринган. В общем он должен стать очень опасен за эти пять лет. Пропиши характеристики и основные техники. Развивай так же линию с получением нового звания и заданий. А также реакции деревни. При этом не забывай про скрытность и шпионаж.
followup: Нужно что бы ты прописал мне конкретные техники которыми владеет Шики и пожалуйста немного, я не смогу вести конспект. Да, ты прописал, я не увидел.
point_of_view: Only Shiki's direct experiences, mission reports he personally received and words personally heard are playable knowledge. Autonomous NPC deeds otherwise hidden in GM-only state. No involuntary Shiki speech/thoughts invented.
summary: Five years of prolonged publicly documented operational development, exceptional speed and careful secret somatic assimilation research. Shiki officially Jonin; Shunshin peak S+ compares to / occasionally exceeds Shisui in straight burst, no superior foresight or literal teleport. True Ice Release from Haku archival donor tissue, limited partial Hozuki Hydrification, Sharingan not obtained.

phases.public_player_experienced: Field Chunin does fast medical aid, B-grade patrol and caravan reconnaissance, grows close-range scalpel accuracy and taijutsu. Tose assesses mission objectives; a rescued border scout later dies despite Shiki emergency efforts, not every save succeeds. Seina still teaches medical evidence not rhetoric.
phases.secret_player_experienced: Sets up personal clandestine laboratory in abandoned drainage building away from Kusa clinic; builds cold storage, separate sealed logs and strict no-mentor disclosure, starts controlled self-adaptation tests; early donor assays fail, causes transient inflammation, no new kekkei genkai yet.

phases.public_player_experienced: Leads recon of border water routes, anti-tail drills and covert identity operations with established Kusa assignments; trains speed and Chakra reserve without fixed automatic boosts per day; earns reputation for completing tactical evacuation not for all-killing.
phases.secret_player_experienced: During authorized surveillance assignment in Water Country, uses his covert infiltration knowledge to separately take cryo-chakra-preserved sample catalogued as belonging to deceased Haku from old hunter-nin forensic medical archive, sample collected while Haku was alive. Haku already dead; Shiki does not meet him or steal from living Haku. He verifies archive provenance enough for his own research, does not prove no fraud possible. Initial somatic incorporation causes fever and brief fine motor deficits, resolves with time and care. Starts learning wind-nature chakra to prepare Hyoton.

phases.public_player_experienced: Kusa promotions board offers Tokubetsu Jonin rank in 1281-11-21 based on medical infiltration and command skill. Tose present, privately warns protecting squad and informing companions where feasible matter more than speed. Shiki also practices advanced illusion disruption, Suiton and Raiton.
phases.secret_player_experienced: 1281-03 first reproducible stable Haku-derived somatic compatibility: true Hyoton established from combined trained Suiton and Fuuton, no inherited memory of his original jutsu. First independent ice mirror reflections work with water, prepared plane and momentum; harsh cold burn and severe chakra expense remain limits.

phases.public_player_experienced: Receives varied B/A assignments for medical support, counter-infiltration and command; a 1282 night extraction loses one injured scout despite organized response; recorded as mission shortcoming rather than flawless legend. Ren pursues separate aggressive short-blade command line, Aki pursues traps/counter-infiltration independently. Both no longer Shiki's subordinates by default.
phases.secret_player_experienced: Acquires a second specimen of deceased Hozuki-line patient from discontinued Water Country medical stock, no confirmed violence against living donor. By 1282-08 obtains stable limited partial local body hydration in arms, skin, fascia, selected muscle vascular compartments. Never whole-body liquid, bones and brain remain solid. Raiton from adversary and loss of water dangerous. These are the second successful genetic assimilation.

phases.public_player_experienced: On 1283-05-15 Kusa command awards regular Jonin rank with assessed command, infiltration, medical precision and high-speed operational successes. Five-year official missions 68 (21 C,32 B,13 A,2 S) carried out by changing squads, not all solo. Other shinobi react differently: wary of fast unemotional medic, rely on his expertise, sometimes question legality of secretive observation. Tose remains senior operations overseer. Aki healed enough for active duty, now Tokubetsu Jonin counter-infiltration/traps; Ren Tokubetsu Jonin specializing close assault. Tose, Aki and Ren have no automatic knowledge of gene experiments. Seina still physician mentor and clinic leader, private medical concern.
phases.secret_player_experienced: Refines Haku ice formation, Hozuki partial tissue fluidization and long-term Zero Genome compatibility mapping; S+ peak Shunshin on straight prepared routes 25–35m in 0.25–0.35 seconds, chain bursts 3–4 then fatigue. Develops only seven core named techniques (see character sheet), no need memorize others; routine medical/sensory/elemental manipulation are unnamed capabilities. Investigates Sharingan viability and covert ocular tissue intelligence as future medium-range aim: NOT acquired, implanted or activated.

mission_record.quality: Credible exceptional five-year operative record, losses and extraction costs; two S operations conducted as part of units rather than lone legend.

village_known_directly_by_shiki: Promotion orders and recognition, accompanied by demands to lead actual colleagues, not a Kage title
Some colleagues actively seek rapid rescue; some respectfully distrust unusual physiology and severe medical combat style, as expressed in person or written feedback
Seina pushes confidentiality and sound clinical validation; she knows childhood syndrome but not donor assimilation
Tose appraises tactical success and the survival of team, not personal affection
Aki independently pursues traps and counter-infiltration, Ren pursues assault missions, their own goals and careers continue
Certain command circles are wary of Shiki's covert work but cannot officially claim Hyoton or Hozuki assimilation.
gm_only_background: Kusa intelligence investigates Water Country archival breaches without certain culprit, records not necessarily connected to Shiki
Kabuto and Orochimaru continue autonomous plans distinct from local medical crime, their current whereabouts and all motives are not known to Shiki
The old K-17 consultant code, 37/6/1 ledger and dossier Kusa records remain unresolved or confidential; Shiki does not gain omniscience from skip

secret_disclosures.to_player: Shiki knows he personally performed two clandestine absorptions with costs and sourced archival donors, and knows Sharingan remains goal
secret_disclosures.to_seina: She knows only original anomaly/early Kabuto blood refusal and public medical skill unless later in-game proof
secret_disclosures.to_aki: No proof of either secret assimilation
secret_disclosures.to_ren: No proof of either secret assimilation
secret_disclosures.to_tose: Only public official capability and character reputation; no proven source of Ice Release or Hydrification

starting_scene.location: Кусагакуре, центральный лазарет, изолированная диагностическая комната
starting_scene.source: Shiki personally summoned to Seina's office for abnormal patient registration; he can see patient and documents
starting_scene.immediate_issue: An adult patient looks like a photograph of a man officially declared dead in 1280. Identity not verified; he seeks medical attention, not necessarily enemy. Patient's wrist has three old parallel surgical scars similar to 1278 found witness, but not causal proof.
starting_scene.stop_at: Seina requests Shiki's medical evaluation, no auto examination, no autonomous Shiki dialogue or voluntary treatment.
